name: cubetrace
description: Chrome web app that records speedcube solves in sync with a GAN Bluetooth cube.

scripts.lint: npm run typecheck && eslint . --ignore-pattern "apps/web/**" && npm run lint -w @cubetrace/web
scripts.test:rules: npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cubetrace "vitest run --config firebase/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.test:functions: npm run build -w @cubetrace/functions && npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only firestore --project demo-cubetrace "vitest run --config functions/vitest.config.ts"
scripts.e2e:cloud: npm run build -w @cubetrace/functions && npm run firebase -- emulators:exec --only auth,firestore,functions --project demo-cubetrace "playwright test -c apps/web/e2e/playwright.config.ts --project cloud"
